_comment: EDITORIAL, NOT OFFICIAL. Real jurisdiction is defined by chamber rules and is messier than this. Generated by a model from committee names, reviewed once, and committed as data -- see congress_trades/jurisdiction.py. It exists to surface 'traded in an industry their committee oversees' as a prompt to go look, never as a finding.
